items.title: Jack Palmer interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 24, 1997
items.q: So there was Zeke Zarchy playing lead, I played second in the hot chair, and Barney Zudicoff played third trumpet.

ctx.x: Permission from the union rep or whatever?

The union, yeah. Because it would be a union job, and your name would go into the records and so forth and so on. Anyway, the day I got my card, there was a band that I was rehearsing with. It was what they call a rehearsal band. Musicians came in from out of town, and then somebody heard them and they went with a band on the road, or things, it was one of those kind of bands. Brick Fleegle. And I was in that band and George Wettling heard me. And he says, “You know Red Norvo and Mildred Bailey?” And I said,…
